subject.title: fix(voice-call): fail-closed media-stream auth for non-Twilio providers

question: Should the classic media-stream endpoint adopt VoiceCallProvider.isValidStreamToken as its permanent fail-closed authentication contract?
rationale: The implementation closes the bypass, but it also creates a compatibility-sensitive provider API and intentionally rejects streams that previously passed without credentials.

options.title: Approve the provider hook
options.body: Keep the generic fail-closed seam and require every future classic-stream provider to implement matching credential transport, validation, and regression tests.

options.title: Narrow to Twilio-only
options.body: Reject non-Twilio classic starts directly and defer the provider API until a second provider genuinely implements this media path.

recommendation.title: Approve the provider hook
recommendation.body: Keep the generic fail-closed seam and require every future classic-stream provider to implement matching credential transport, validation, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and contribution history show the broadest ownership of the affected classic and realtime voice-streaming boundary.
